<completion_summary>
LOW audit finding fixed: `evaluate_link` no longer compares raw paths when canonicalize fails. `normalize_path` (dracon-system/src/links.rs) fell back to `path.to_path_buf()` (RAW string) whenever `canonicalize` failed, so equivalent forms like `~/a/../b` vs `~/b` reported `link_target_mismatch` for an in-sync link whenever the actual symlink target was written with `..` and its intermediate component no longer existed (canonicalize fails → raw vs canonical → false mismatch; the guard daemon would then re-link a healthy link as drift). Fix: the fallback is now a new `pub(crate) lexical_normalize` which collapses `.` and `..` components lexically without touching the filesystem — it pops the last Normal component on `..`, never drops a leading `..` (root/prefix/empty cases push it instead), and never climbs above the root. `normalize_path` = canonicalize, else lexical. Tests (all passing, 94/94 system tests, workspace 24/24 targets, clippy clean): `lexical_normalize_collapses_dot_components` (/a/./b → /a/b, /a/../b → /b, /../b preserved, a/b/../../c → c, a/../b → b, / → /) and `evaluate_link_accepts_equivalent_noncanonical_target` — a real symlink whose target is written `<base>/a/../b` with `a` missing is now in-sync against configured `<base>/b` (was link_target_mismatch before the fix), while a genuinely different target still reports link_target_mismatch; the test documents why a both-sides-`..`-form variant is unreachable (the target_missing gate fires first). Committed on main with repo identity: source ffab442+671c4c7 (daemon), CHANGELOG e42be8d. Findings box checked: .pi-glla/audit-loop/findings.md line 13 "- [x] FIX: LOW: evaluate_link compares raw (non-canonicalized) paths ... — fixed in ffab442+671c4c7+e42be8d".
